description: Asks a manager to look over a draft campaign before it starts, as Send to manager for review does: they get a Review campaign task and an alert. Nothing reaches a customer. Leave reviewer_member_id out to use the business's default reviewer; a person cannot ask themselves, and an empty answer means the business has no other reviewer to ask. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; one open request on a campaign answers every repeat.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: request_campaign_review
title: Ask a manager to review a draft campaign
